scientific_integrity: No independent validation, priority certification or authorship claims; analytic and combinatorial reasoning is supplied in RESULT.md and finite tests in checker.py.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unlabelled finite unary functions satisfying f^3=f^2 only; fixed FO sentences and finite fixed lists of component isomorphism types. The qualitative zero-one law and exact enumeration are established prior work. The logarithmic limit law and FO rate have a symbolic saddle-point proof; finite checks do not certify asymptotic claims. Older weighted-partition or permutation-structure literature may subsume a quantitative part.
title: Sharp logarithmic first-order limits for unlabelled height-two unary forests
